job.title: Site Manager - Tallangatta
job.description:
About RWM
Regional Workforce Management (RWM) is proudly Australian-owned, dedicated to connecting businesses with tailored recruitment and workforce management solutions since 2000. Formerly FIP Group, we’ve spent over two decades supporting the backbone of Australia - the food, agriculture, forestry and fisheries industries. By blending local expertise with a national reach, we deliver reliable and committed people who help businesses grow, thrive and stand strong.
  
What started as a small operation helping local businesses quickly grew into something much bigger. Our founders’ ability to connect with people - sharing experiences, solutions and hope – helped forge strong bonds with businesses and communities alike. As we expanded from labour hire to permanent recruitment and into connecting skilled workers from across the borders, our mission has remained the same: to provide real solutions that save Australia’s food and agriculture business time and resources.

We are powered by PeopleIN - Australia's largest ASX-listed family of workforce solutions brands.

The Opportunity
We are seeking a Site Manager to work onsite at one of our client's locations, Tallangatta. 

In this role, you will be responsible for the following:
  • People welfare, including onboarding, probationary checks and discussions, issuing warning and termination letters, and employee retention
  • Payroll reconciliations regarding timesheet management
  • PLS (Pacific Labour Scheme) worker mobilisation
  • Transporting employees to clinics, in the case of an incident
  • Reports for VEVO checks
  • Management of clients and employees
  • Attendance management
What You Will Need
To be successful in this role you will have a drive to deliver and be a highly organised individual. You will be passionate about helping others succeed and be committed to this role. 

You will also:
  • Have experience managing people and teams
  • Administration/HR/payroll experience is highly desirable
  • Have a Drivers licence and vehicle
  • Be willing to obtain a Police Check
  • Be vaccinated against against COVID-19
  • Be willing and able to be vaccinated against QFever
If this sounds like you, APPLY NOW!

Please note only successful applicants will be contacted.
